first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify its effects on qualification, retention, and unit economics before committing, while using activation messaging as the strongest relevant alternative given the 6% activation decline. Start with a guarded test because discount-driven acquisition may reduce downstream customer value.

final.rationale: Run an in-product activation messaging experiment. The verified source showed a 6% activation lift, matching the current 6% decline, plus 11% higher week-one engagement and no retention harm. Reject promotional pricing because verified evidence showed 12% lower 30-day retention, making its revenue lift unsustainable. A standard experiment preserves measurement of qualified-revenue impact before broader rollout.
